shortDescription: Manages identity-provider objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: base64_certificate
options.description: Certificate file encoded in base64 based on provider data. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'data-receiving' is set to 'manually'.

options.name: base64_metadata_file
options.description: Metadata file encoded in base64 based on the provider data. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'data-receiving' is set to 'metadata_file'.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: data_receiving
options.description: Data receiving method from the SAML Identity Provider.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Gateway for the SAML Identity Provider usage. Identified by name or UID. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'usage' is set to 'gateway_policy_and_logs'.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: login_url
options.description: Login URL based on the provider data. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'data-receiving' is set to 'manually'.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: received_identifier
options.description: Received Identifier (Entity ID) based on the provider data. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'data-receiving' is set to 'manually'.

options.name: service
options.description: Service for the selected gateway. <font color="red">Required only when</font> 'usage' is set to 'gateway_policy_and_logs'.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: usage
options.description: Usage of Identity Provider.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
